# Read in Data
```{r global options,  warning=FALSE}
library(psych)
library(readr)
library(MASS)
library(sjPlot)

d <- read_rds("~/Box Sync/Lifting the Bar Materials & Data/LTB Data/LTB School Data/Cleaned Data/Discipline_Counts_Cleaned.rds")
sessionInfo()

```

# Base Model
```{r warning=FALSE}
model1 <- glm.nb(comb_post ~ cond_f, 
                 data = d) 

tab_model(model1, show.stat = T, string.stat = "z-value", 
          dv.labels = "Model 1", string.p = "P-Value",
          pred.labels = c("Intercept", "Student Treatment", "Student Treatment + Letter"))

# the condition estimate is B, the log count coefficient
summary(model1)

# mean citation counts and SE
describeBy(d$comb_post, d$cond_f)

# how many participants per condition in this analysis?
table(model1$model$cond_f) 
```

# Model with controls
```{r warning=FALSE}
model3 <- glm.nb(comb_post ~ cond_f + immPre + s0.demo_edu_mom
                 + s0.personality_c3, data = d) 

tab_model(model3, show.stat = T, string.stat = "z-value", dv.labels = "Model 3", string.p = "P-Value",
          pred.labels = c("Intercept",
            "Student Treatment", "Student Treatment + Letter", "Prior Term Citations", "Mother's education", "Baseline IT Personality"))

# the condition estimate is B, the log count coefficient
summary(model3)

# how many participants per condition in this analysis?
table(model3$model$cond_f) 
```
